fullText.simplified:
钱老板的信（下）

    我没有告诉白秘书我的身体不行了。我去医院看了医生，我生病了，医生说我的时间不多了。最近几个月，我的公司不太好。这一年来，我花太多时间跟白秘书在一起了，没有认真工作。现在我很着急，我想让公司快点好起来。
    最近我用了公司的最后一笔钱，我还从银行借了很多钱，我把这些钱给了一家公司，他们说可以很快地帮我拿到更多的钱。这个公司叫“天乐”，老板姓高。我知道自己这个决定有点儿着急，但是我的时间不多了。这个高老板又是白秘书介绍给我的，我相信她，不会有问题的。
    爱是多么可笑的东西啊！我爱错了一个人，我那么相信她，最后我什么都没有了。白秘书爱过我吗？没有！她喜欢过我吗？她有一点点喜欢过我吗？没有！她爱的是钱！
    她骗了我。她弟弟出国读书不是真的，她说的话不是真的。她有丈夫，她和她的丈夫骗了我两千万。我是一个多么没用的男人啊，我没有了钱，没有了公司。我公司的人还不知道自己要没有工作了，他们还在给我准备生日蛋糕，他们还跟我说“生日快乐”。
    我的身体不行了，我的时间不多了。医生说我还有三个月左右的时间，我就要死了。现在的我，没有了公司，没有了钱，我爱的人骗了我。我很难过，我想死，我想快点死！
    我准备了毒药，在我的咖啡里放了毒药。我喝了咖啡，再见了，这个世界。我的心真的太累了，没有人爱我，他们只爱我的钱。
    我叫钱常乐。钱，真的是能给人快乐的东西吗？
fullText.traditional:
錢老闆的信（下）

    我沒有告訴白秘書我的身體不行了。我去醫院看了醫生，我生病了，醫生說我的時間不多了。最近幾個月，我的公司不太好。這一年來，我花太多時間跟白秘書在一起了，沒有認真工作。現在我很著急，我想讓公司快點好起來。
    最近我用了公司的最後一筆錢，我還從銀行借了很多錢，我把這些錢給了一家公司，他們說可以很快地幫我拿到更多的錢。這個公司叫“天樂”，老闆姓高。我知道自己這個決定有點兒著急，但是我的時間不多了。這個高老闆又是白秘書介紹給我的，我相信她，不會有問題的。
    愛是多麼可笑的東西啊！我愛錯了一個人，我那麼相信她，最後我什麼都沒有了。白秘書愛過我嗎？沒有！她喜歡過我嗎？她有一點點喜歡過我嗎？沒有！她愛的是錢！
    她騙了我。她弟弟出國讀書不是真的，她說的話不是真的。她有丈夫，她和她的丈夫騙了我兩千萬。我是一個多麼沒用的男人啊，我沒有了錢，沒有了公司。我公司的人還不知道自己要沒有工作了，他們還在給我準備生日蛋糕，他們還跟我說“生日快樂”。
    我的身體不行了，我的時間不多了。醫生說我還有三個月左右的時間，我就要死了。現在的我，沒有了公司，沒有了錢，我愛的人騙了我。我很難過，我想死，我想快點死！
    我準備了毒藥，在我的咖啡裡放了毒藥。我喝了咖啡，再見了，這個世界。我的心真的太累了，沒有人愛我，他們只愛我的錢。
    我叫錢常樂。錢，真的是能給人快樂的東西嗎？

sentences.simplified: 我没有告诉白秘书我的身体不行了。
sentences.traditional: 我沒有告訴白秘書我的身體不行了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu gào su bái mì shū wǒ de shēn tǐ bù xíng le
sentences.english: I didn’t tell Secretary Bai that I was dying.

sentences.simplified: 我去医院看了医生，我生病了，医生说我的时间不多了。
sentences.traditional: 我去醫院看了醫生，我生病了，醫生說我的時間不多了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ qù yī yuàn kàn le yī shēng wǒ shēng bìng le yī shēng shuō wǒ de shí jiān bù duō le
sentences.english: I went to the hospital to see a doctor. I was sick, and the doctor said that I didn’t have much time left.

sentences.simplified: 最近几个月，我的公司不太好。
sentences.traditional: 最近幾個月，我的公司不太好。
sentences.pinyin: zuì jìn jǐ ge yuè wǒ de gōng sī bú tài hǎo
sentences.english: In recent months, my company hasn’t been doing very well.

sentences.simplified: 这一年来，我花太多时间跟白秘书在一起了，没有认真工作。
sentences.traditional: 這一年來，我花太多時間跟白秘書在一起了，沒有認真工作。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì nián lái wǒ huā tài duō shí jiān gēn bái mì shū zài yì qǐ le méi yǒu rèn zhēn gōng zuò
sentences.english: This past year, I spent too much time with Secretary Bai and did not take work seriously.

sentences.simplified: 现在我很着急，我想让公司快点好起来。
sentences.traditional: 現在我很著急，我想讓公司快點好起來。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ hěn zháo jí wǒ xiǎng ràng gōng sī kuài diǎn hǎo qǐ lái
sentences.english: Now, I was very worried, and I wanted the company to improve quickly.

sentences.simplified: 最近我用了公司的最后一笔钱，我还从银行借了很多钱，
sentences.traditional: 最近我用了公司的最後一筆錢，我還從銀行借了很多錢，
sentences.pinyin: zuì jìn wǒ yòng le gōng sī de zuì hòu yì bǐ qián wǒ hái cóng yín háng jiè le hěn duō qián
sentences.english: Recently, I used the company’s last sum of money. I also borrowed a lot of money from the bank.

sentences.simplified: 我把这些钱给了一家公司，他们说可以很快地帮我拿到更多的钱。
sentences.traditional: 我把這些錢給了一家公司，他們說可以很快地幫我拿到更多的錢。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē qián gěi le yì jiā gōng sī tā men shuō kě yǐ hěn kuài de bāng wǒ ná dào gèng duō de qián
sentences.english: I gave this money to another company. They said they could help me get more money very quickly.

sentences.simplified: 这个公司叫“天乐”，老板姓高。
sentences.traditional: 這個公司叫“天樂”，老闆姓高。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge gōng sī jiào tiān lè lǎo bǎn xìng gāo
sentences.english: This company was called “Tianle”, and its owner had the surname Gao.

sentences.simplified: 我知道自己这个决定有点儿着急，但是我的时间不多了。
sentences.traditional: 我知道自己這個決定有點兒著急，但是我的時間不多了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ zhè ge jué dìng yǒu diǎn'r zháo jí dàn shì wǒ de shí jiān bù duō le
sentences.english: I know that this decision was rather rushed, but I didn’t have a lot of time left.

sentences.simplified: 这个高老板又是白秘书介绍给我的，我相信她，不会有问题的。
sentences.traditional: 這個高老闆又是白秘書介紹給我的，我相信她，不會有問題的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge gāo lǎo bǎn yòu shì bái mì shū jiè shào gěi wǒ de wǒ xiāng xìn tā bú huì yǒu wèn tí de
sentences.english: This Boss Gao was introduced to me by Secretary Bai. I trusted her; everything was going to be fine.

sentences.simplified: 爱是多么可笑的东西啊！我爱错了一个人，我那么相信她，最后我什么都没有了。
sentences.traditional: 愛是多麼可笑的東西啊！我愛錯了一個人，我那麼相信她，最後我什麼都沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: ài shì duō me kě xiào de dōng xi a wǒ ài cuò le yí ge rén wǒ nà me xiāng xìn tā zuì hòu wǒ shén me dōu méi yǒu le
sentences.english: What a ridiculous thing love is! I loved the wrong person. I trusted her so much, and in the end, I had nothing.

sentences.simplified: 白秘书爱过我吗？没有！她喜欢过我吗？
sentences.traditional: 白秘書愛過我嗎？沒有！她喜歡過我嗎？
sentences.pinyin: bái mì shū ài guò wǒ ma méi yǒu tā xǐ huan guò wǒ ma
sentences.english: Did Secretary Bai ever love me? No! Did she ever like me?

sentences.simplified: 她有一点点喜欢过我吗？没有！她爱的是钱！
sentences.traditional: 她有一點點喜歡過我嗎？沒有！她愛的是錢！
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu yì diǎn diǎn xǐ huan guò wǒ ma méi yǒu tā ài de shì qián
sentences.english: Did she ever like me even a little bit? No! What she loves is money!

sentences.simplified: 她骗了我。她弟弟出国读书不是真的，她说的话不是真的。
sentences.traditional: 她騙了我。她弟弟出國讀書不是真的，她說的話不是真的。
sentences.pinyin: tā piàn le wǒ tā dì di chū guó dú shū bú shì zhēn de tā shuō de huà bú shì zhēn de
sentences.english: She cheated me. Her younger brother studying abroad was not real, and her words were not true.

sentences.simplified: 她有丈夫，她和她的丈夫骗了我两千万。
sentences.traditional: 她有丈夫，她和她的丈夫騙了我兩千萬。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu zhàng fu tā hé tā de zhàng fu piàn le wǒ liǎng qiān wàn
sentences.english: She had a husband, and she and her husband cheated 20 million from me.

sentences.simplified: 我是一个多么没用的男人啊，我没有了钱，没有了公司。
sentences.traditional: 我是一個多麼沒用的男人啊，我沒有了錢，沒有了公司。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shì yí ge duō me méi yòng de nán rén a wǒ méi yǒu le qián méi yǒu le gōng sī
sentences.english: I am a useless person. I no longer have any money, and I no longer have a company.

sentences.simplified: 我公司的人还不知道自己要没有工作了，
sentences.traditional: 我公司的人還不知道自己要沒有工作了，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ gōng sī de rén hái bù zhī dào zì jǐ yào méi yǒu gōng zuò le
sentences.english: The people at my company still don’t know that they are going to be out of work.

sentences.simplified: 他们还在给我准备生日蛋糕，他们还跟我说“生日快乐”。
sentences.traditional: 他們還在給我準備生日蛋糕，他們還跟我說“生日快樂”。
sentences.pinyin: tā men hái zài gěi wǒ zhǔn bèi shēng rì dàn gāo tā men hái gēn wǒ shuō shēng rì kuài lè
sentences.english: They still prepared a birthday cake for me, and they still said “happy birthday” to me.

sentences.simplified: 我的身体不行了，我的时间不多了。医生说我还有三个月左右的时间，我就要死了。
sentences.traditional: 我的身體不行了，我的時間不多了。醫生說我還有三個月左右的時間，我就要死了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de shēn tǐ bù xíng le wǒ de shí jiān bù duō le yī shēng shuō wǒ hái yǒu sān ge yuè zuǒ yòu de shí jiān wǒ jiù yào sǐ le
sentences.english: I am dying, and I don’t have much time left. The doctor said that I still have three months or so. I am about to die.

sentences.simplified: 现在的我，没有了公司，没有了钱，我爱的人骗了我。
sentences.traditional: 現在的我，沒有了公司，沒有了錢，我愛的人騙了我。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài de wǒ méi yǒu le gōng sī méi yǒu le qián wǒ ài de rén piàn le wǒ
sentences.english: Now, I don’t have a company, and I don’t have money. The person I love cheated me.

sentences.simplified: 我很难过，我想死，我想快点死！
sentences.traditional: 我很難過，我想死，我想快點死！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn nán guò wǒ xiǎng sǐ wǒ xiǎng kuài diǎn sǐ
sentences.english: I am very sad. I want to die. I want to die quickly!

sentences.simplified: 我准备了毒药，在我的咖啡里放了毒药。我喝了咖啡，再见了，这个世界。
sentences.traditional: 我準備了毒藥，在我的咖啡裡放了毒藥。我喝了咖啡，再見了，這個世界。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǔn bèi le dú yào zài wǒ de kā fēi lǐ fàng le dú yào wǒ hē le kā fēi zài jiàn le zhè ge shì jiè
sentences.english: I have prepared poison. I have put the poison in my coffee. I have drunk the coffee. Goodbye, this world.

sentences.simplified: 我的心真的太累了，没有人爱我，他们只爱我的钱。
sentences.traditional: 我的心真的太累了，沒有人愛我，他們只愛我的錢。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de xīn zhēn de tài lèi le méi yǒu rén ài wǒ tā men zhǐ ài wǒ de qián
sentences.english: My heart is really tired. No one loves me. They only love my money.

sentences.simplified: 我叫钱常乐。钱，真的是能给人快乐的东西吗？
sentences.traditional: 我叫錢常樂。錢，真的是能給人快樂的東西嗎？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiào qián cháng lè qián zhēn de shì néng gěi rén kuài lè de dōng xi ma
sentences.english: My name is Qian Changle. Money—is this really something that can bring people happiness?

sentence_translations: Letter from Boss Qian (2)
I didn’t tell Secretary Bai that I was dying.
I went to the hospital to see a doctor. I was sick, and the doctor said that I didn’t have much time left.
In recent months, my company hasn’t been doing very well.
This past year, I spent too much time with Secretary Bai and did not take work seriously.
Now, I was very worried, and I wanted the company to improve quickly.
Recently, I used the company’s last sum of money. I also borrowed a lot of money from the bank.
I gave this money to another company. They said they could help me get more money very quickly.
This company was called “Tianle”, and its owner had the surname Gao.
I know that this decision was rather rushed, but I didn’t have a lot of time left.
This Boss Gao was introduced to me by Secretary Bai. I trusted her; everything was going to be fine.
What a ridiculous thing love is! I loved the wrong person. I trusted her so much, and in the end, I had nothing.
Did Secretary Bai ever love me? No! Did she ever like me?
Did she ever like me even a little bit? No! What she loves is money!
She cheated me. Her younger brother studying abroad was not real, and her words were not true.
She had a husband, and she and her husband cheated 20 million from me.
I am a useless person. I no longer have any money, and I no longer have a company.
The people at my company still don’t know that they are going to be out of work.
They still prepared a birthday cake for me, and they still said “happy birthday” to me.
I am dying, and I don’t have much time left. The doctor said that I still have three months or so. I am about to die.
Now, I don’t have a company, and I don’t have money. The person I love cheated me.
I am very sad. I want to die. I want to die quickly!
I have prepared poison. I have put the poison in my coffee. I have drunk the coffee. Goodbye, this world.
My heart is really tired. No one loves me. They only love my money.
My name is Qian Changle. Money—is this really something that can bring people happiness?
